sentences.en: When we think about COVID, we're usually thinking about how it affects humans.
sentences.zh: 当我们想到新冠病毒时，通常会想到它如何影响人类。

sentences.en: But COVID most likely did not originate in us, but in some other animal.
sentences.zh: 但新冠病毒很可能并非起源于人类，而是起源于其他动物。

sentences.en: Most likely it was a bat, and from there it may have crossed over into some other intermediary species before making its way into humans.
sentences.zh: 最可能是蝙蝠，然后它可能在进入人类体内之前，先传染给了某种中间宿主。

sentences.en: When pathogens cross species barriers into humans, we call it a spillover.
sentences.zh: 当病原体跨越物种屏障进入人类时，我们称之为“溢出”。

sentences.en: It's how we've gotten diseases like measles, influenza, and smallpox, among many others.
sentences.zh: 我们感染麻疹、流感和天花等许多疾病都是通过这种方式。

sentences.en: But spillover is not the end of the story.
sentences.zh: 但溢出并不是故事的终点。

sentences.en: Pathogens continue to move across species boundaries even after they erupt in humans.
sentences.zh: 病原体即使在人类中爆发后，仍会继续跨越物种界限传播。

sentences.en: We've seen evidence of COVID infections in free-living species such as white-tailed deer.
sentences.zh: 我们已经看到了新冠病毒在白尾鹿等野生动物中感染的证据。

sentences.en: We've also seen it in a range of zoo animals.
sentences.zh: 我们也曾在各种动物园动物身上发现过它。

sentences.en: And even our family cats and dogs are susceptible to being infected.
sentences.zh: 甚至我们家里的猫狗也容易受到感染。

sentences.en: When this happens, we call it spillback.
sentences.zh: 当这种情况发生时，我们称之为“溢回”。

sentences.en: My name is Sonia Shah.
sentences.zh: 我叫索尼娅·沙阿。

sentences.en: I'm a science journalist and author, and I'm sharing a story about spillback that I wrote for the New York Times magazine.

sentences.en: Back in the spring of 2020, when I first heard about minks getting infected with COVID
sentences.zh: 早在2020年春天，当我第一次听说水貂感染新冠病毒时，

sentences.en: on a scale that was just unprecedented compared to any other species besides humans, I went to the
sentences.zh: 其规模之大，在人类以外的任何物种中都是前所未有的，我便前往了

sentences.en: epicenter of the mink COVID outbreak in the United States in Utah County, outside Salt Lake City.
sentences.zh: 美国水貂新冠疫情的中心——盐湖城郊外的犹他县。

sentences.en: Minks are in the same family as ferrets, weasels, and otters.
sentences.zh: 水貂与雪貂、黄鼠狼和水獭属于同一科。

sentences.en: They've been hunted for their soft, lustrous fur for centuries, but now people are also able to raise them on factory farMs.
sentences.zh: 几个世纪以来，人们一直为了它们柔软、有光泽的皮毛而猎杀它们，但现在人们也可以在工厂化农场中饲养它们。

sentences.en: It's a huge challenge to find these farMs. These places don't publicize where they are.
sentences.zh: 找到这些农场是一个巨大的挑战。这些地方不会公开它们的位置。

sentences.en: But I did know that mink farms are visually distinctive.
sentences.zh: 但我确实知道水貂养殖场在视觉上很有辨识度。

sentences.en: They have these long, white, narrow sheds, and you can see them on Google Maps satellite images.
sentences.zh: 它们有长长、白色、狭窄的棚屋，你可以在谷歌地图的卫星图像上看到它们。

sentences.en: So I drove around looking for those sheds and pulled up into these places and knocked on some doors.
sentences.zh: 所以我开车四处寻找那些棚屋，开到这些地方，敲开了一些门。

sentences.en: I presumed that the farms themselves would be impenetrable.
sentences.zh: 我原以为这些农场本身会是密不透风的。

sentences.en: But on some of them, they weren't.
sentences.zh: 但在其中一些地方，并非如此。

sentences.en: There was hardly any security at all.
sentences.zh: 几乎没有任何安保措施。

sentences.en: I found that really striking.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这真的很惊人。

sentences.en: I did some reporting years ago on wet markets in China around the first SARS outbreak.
sentences.zh: 多年前，我曾报道过中国在首次SARS爆发期间的湿货市场。

sentences.en: And what I saw in Utah County reminded me of that in a lot of ways.
sentences.zh: 我在犹他县看到的情景在很多方面让我想起了那次经历。

sentences.en: These mink farms are facilities that crowd tens of thousands of animals in long rows of wire cages with no plumbing systeMs. The animals are
sentences.zh: 这些水貂养殖场将数万只动物挤在长排的铁丝笼里，没有管道系统。动物们

sentences.en: continuously breathing each other's air.
sentences.zh: 不断地呼吸着彼此的空气。

sentences.en: It's a very high transmission scenario.
sentences.zh: 这是一个极高传播风险的场景。

sentences.en: Once a pathogen such as COVID is introduced, it can spread like wildfire.
sentences.zh: 一旦引入像新冠病毒这样的病原体，它就会像野火一样蔓延。

sentences.en: The virus can radiate out into other species too.
sentences.zh: 病毒也可以辐射到其他物种身上。

sentences.en: I saw feral cats passing by, flocks of seagulls circling overhead, a family of turkeys on one farm.
sentences.zh: 我看到野猫经过，成群的海鸥在头顶盘旋，一个农场里还有一群火鸡。

sentences.en: The interactions between all of these species on mink farms provides even more opportunities for the virus to explore novel bodies and change in new ways.
sentences.zh: 水貂养殖场中所有这些物种之间的互动，为病毒探索新的身体并以新的方式变异提供了更多机会。

sentences.en: And this fact that COVID as a human pandemic is now spilling back into wildlife, where it will
sentences.zh: 而新冠病毒作为一种人类大流行病，现在正溢回到野生动物身上，它将在那里

sentences.en: continue to evolve out of our sight and control, it feels like a stage in a journey that's just beginning.
sentences.zh: 在我们视线和控制之外继续进化，这感觉就像是一段刚刚开始的旅程中的一个阶段。

sentences.en: So here's my article.
sentences.zh: 这就是我的文章。

sentences.en: Animals that infect humans are scary.
sentences.zh: 感染人类的动物很可怕。

sentences.en: It's worse when we infect them back.
sentences.zh: 当我们反过来感染它们时，情况更糟。

sentences.en: A mink farm in northern Utah sat at the end of a narrow, rutted road lined by modest, densely packed ranch houses.
sentences.zh: 犹他州北部的一个水貂养殖场坐落在一条狭窄、坑洼不平的道路尽头，路边排列着朴素、密集的牧场房屋。

sentences.en: The farm consisted of a grassy lot partly enclosed by stakes with wire wrapped haphazardly around them and a small chain-link swing gate.
sentences.zh: 该农场由一块草地组成，部分被木桩围住，木桩上随意缠绕着铁丝，还有一个小型链式秋千门。

sentences.en: Long, narrow mink sheds a few yards beyond the gate were so close to the road that I could see inside their dark interiors.
sentences.zh: 门外几码处长而狭窄的水貂棚屋离路边很近，我可以看到它们黑暗的内部。

sentences.en: The smell from the sheds was intense.
sentences.zh: 棚屋里散发出的气味非常强烈。

sentences.en: Mink keep intruders away from their territories by emitting an odor from their anal scent glands that is widely considered to be more pungent than that of skunks.
sentences.zh: 水貂通过肛门腺散发出一种气味来驱赶领地内的入侵者，这种气味被普遍认为比臭鼬的气味更刺鼻。

sentences.en: A thoroughfare in a nearby city that is home to several mink farms is colloquially known as Satan's Butthole.
sentences.zh: 附近城市的一条主干道上有几个水貂养殖场，被俗称为“撒旦的肛门”。

sentences.en: A neighbor, an adolescent girl with a mass of black curls, offered to help me
sentences.zh: 一位邻居，一个留着一头黑色卷发的青春期女孩，主动提出帮我

sentences.en: find the farmer, and I waited as she unlatched the gate and marched into the mink sheds in her flip-flops.
sentences.zh: 找到农场主，我等着她解开门锁，穿着人字拖走进了水貂棚屋。

sentences.en: She located the farmer in one of the sheds, poked her head out, and called me over.
sentences.zh: 她在其中一个棚屋里找到了农场主，探出头来，把我叫了过去。

sentences.en: Having long been targeted by anti-fur activists, mink farms don't announce themselves with signposts or list their names and addresses in directories.
sentences.zh: 由于长期受到反皮草活动人士的针对，水貂养殖场不会用路标标示自己，也不会在名录中列出名称和地址。

sentences.en: When I visited in July, the $20 billion global mink industry was under scrutiny for a different reason.
sentences.zh: 当我七月份去参观时，这个价值200亿美元的全球水貂产业正因另一个原因受到审查。

sentences.en: Mink farmers had been battered by the coronavirus, which first erupted among captive mink in Europe in late April 2020 and on United States farms four months later.
sentences.zh: 水貂养殖户受到了冠状病毒的重创，该病毒于2020年4月下旬首次在欧洲的圈养水貂中爆发，四个月后在美国农场爆发。

sentences.en: By June 2021, scientists estimated, the virus had infected as many as 7 million mink on more than 400 farms in Europe and North America, killing more than 700,000 of the animals.
sentences.zh: 据科学家估计，到2021年6月，该病毒已感染了欧洲和北美400多个农场的多达700万只水貂，导致超过70万只动物死亡。

sentences.en: A death toll orders of magnitude greater than that borne by any other non-human species.
sentences.zh: 死亡人数比任何其他非人类物种所承受的都要高出几个数量级。

sentences.en: By the summer of 2021, coronavirus had infected thousands of mink on a dozen farms in Utah.
sentences.zh: 到2021年夏天，冠状病毒已感染了犹他州十几个农场的数千只水貂。

sentences.en: Four farms in the state were still under quarantine.
sentences.zh: 该州有四个农场仍处于隔离状态。

sentences.en: Inside the shed, the still air was dense with flies.
sentences.zh: 棚屋里，静止的空气中充满了苍蝇。

sentences.en: On either side, rows of wire cages stacked waist-high contained the intertwined bodies of mink.
sentences.zh: 两侧，堆叠到腰部高度的铁丝笼里装着纠缠在一起的水貂尸体。

sentences.en: Most were silently prostrate on their backs, their paws limp in the air, passed out in the nearly
sentences.zh: 大多数都静静地俯卧在背上，爪子无力地悬在空中，在近

sentences.en: 100-degree heat.
sentences.zh: 100华氏度（约38摄氏度）的高温下昏死过去。

sentences.en: Mink waste piled up under their cages in low, long ridges.
sentences.zh: 水貂的排泄物在笼子下堆积成低矮的长脊。

sentences.en: At the end of the narrow dirt aisle between the sheds, the farmer sat on a small tractor outfitted with a special attachment
sentences.zh: 在棚屋之间狭窄的泥土通道尽头，农场主坐在一台装有特殊附件的小型拖拉机上，

sentences.en: that squeezed plops of pinkish meat paste on top of the cages.
sentences.zh: 将一团团粉红色的肉酱挤在笼子顶部。

sentences.en: He wore a headlamp, a walkman, and an affable expression as he looked up at me.
sentences.zh: 他戴着头灯，挂着随身听，抬头看我时露出了和蔼的表情。

sentences.en: I made my way down the aisle between the ridges of mink waste, feeling grateful I wasn't wearing flip-flops.
sentences.zh: 我沿着水貂排泄物脊之间的通道走去，庆幸自己没穿人字拖。

sentences.en: The farmer happily chatted with me about the 13,000 mink he keeps on the farm, which freely exchange aerosols with him, one another,
sentences.zh: 农场主愉快地和我聊起他农场里饲养的13000只水貂，它们与他、彼此之间自由地交换气溶胶，

sentences.en: and any animal that might happen to follow the stench emanating from his unsecured sheds.
sentences.zh: 以及任何可能顺着他那毫无防护的棚屋散发出的恶臭而来的动物。

sentences.en: We may have had a few mink die that might have been from the COVID, he mused, when I asked him how his mink had fared in the first wave of the pandemic.
sentences.zh: “我们可能有几只水貂死于新冠病毒，”当我问他水貂在第一波疫情中表现如何时，他沉思道。

sentences.en: We didn't think it was anything, so we didn't test them.
sentences.zh: “我们以为没什么大不了的，所以没给它们做检测。”

sentences.en: The probability that this latest generation of mink might be infected was, if anything, greater than it was the previous summer.
sentences.zh: 如果说有什么不同的话，这一代水貂被感染的可能性比去年夏天还要大。

sentences.en: COVID-19 cases in Utah were higher, and nearby Salt Lake City was a center of anti-vaccine sentiment in the state.
sentences.zh: 犹他州的新冠病例更多，附近的盐湖城是该州反疫苗情绪的中心。

sentences.en: And while the farmer had already vaccinated his mink against distemper and other diseases, he had no plans to buy the coronavirus vaccine that the
sentences.zh: 虽然农场主已经给他的水貂接种了犬瘟热和其他疾病的疫苗，但他没有计划购买制药公司Zoetis

sentences.en: pharmaceutical company Zoetis had developed for mink and other animals.
sentences.zh: 为水貂和其他动物开发的冠状病毒疫苗。

sentences.en: Even if he did, that vaccine, like its human counterparts, would only reduce disease in mink.
sentences.zh: 即使他买了，那种疫苗也像人类疫苗一样，只能减轻水貂的疾病。

sentences.en: It would not prevent infection, and probably would not prevent transmission either, a Zoetis executive told me.
sentences.zh: 一位Zoetis高管告诉我，它无法预防感染，可能也无法预防传播。

sentences.en: The farmer wore thick leather gloves to protect his hands from the mink's powerful bites, but he did not wear a mask.
sentences.zh: 农场主戴着厚厚的皮手套以保护双手免受水貂强有力的咬伤，但他没有戴口罩。

sentences.en: I was fully vaccinated and had tested myself to ensure I wasn't infected, but he didn't ask me about my vaccine status, nor did he ask me to wear a mask.
sentences.zh: 我已完全接种疫苗并对自己进行了检测以确保没有感染，但他没有问我的疫苗接种情况，也没有要求我戴口罩。

sentences.en: Masking on mink farms, like vaccinations and testing, were not legally required.
sentences.zh: 在水貂养殖场戴口罩，就像疫苗接种和检测一样，在法律上没有强制要求。

sentences.en: Before I left, I asked if I could take his photograph.
sentences.zh: 离开前，我问是否可以给他拍张照。

sentences.en: He reached into a cage, grabbed a mink by the torso, and held it up for the camera.
sentences.zh: 他伸手进笼子，抓住一只水貂的躯干，把它举起来对着镜头。

sentences.en: The mink opened its mouth, inches from the farmer's grinning face, and screeched in terror.
sentences.zh: 水貂张开嘴，离农场主咧开的脸只有几英寸远，惊恐地尖叫起来。

sentences.en: The COVID-19 pandemic has familiarized the world with the word spillover, which means when microbes in the bodies of animals spread into those of humans.
sentences.zh: 新冠疫情让全世界熟悉了“溢出”这个词，意思是动物体内的微生物传播到人类体内。

sentences.en: Less discussed is spillover's mirror image, spillback, also known as reverse zoonosis, by which microbes move from humans into non-human animals.
sentences.zh: 较少讨论的是溢出的镜像——“溢回”，也称为反向人畜共患病，即微生物从人类移动到非人类动物体内。

sentences.en: Not every pandemic-causing pathogen can spill back into non-human species.
sentences.zh: 并非每种引起大流行的病原体都能溢回到非人类物种中。

sentences.en: Some become so genetically partial to Homo sapiens that they can no longer make the crossing, while others may never get the chance.
sentences.zh: 有些在基因上变得如此偏爱智人，以至于无法再跨越，而另一些可能永远没有机会。

sentences.en: But those that can spillover and back expand their reign in the natural world, with unexpected results for both human and non-human animals.
sentences.zh: 但那些能够溢出并溢回的病原体扩大了它们在自然界的统治范围，给人类和非人类动物带来了意想不到的结果。

sentences.en: A spillback can ignite epidemics in wild species, including endangered ones, ravaging whole ecosysteMs. It can establish new wildlife reservoirs that
sentences.zh: 溢回可以在野生动物物种（包括濒危物种）中引发流行病，摧毁整个生态系统。它可以建立新的野生动物宿主，

sentences.en: shift the pathogen's evolutionary trajectory, unleashing novel variants that can fuel new, dangerous waves of disease in humans.
sentences.zh: 改变病原体的进化轨迹，释放出可能助长人类新一轮危险疾病浪潮的新变种。

sentences.en: Some scientists suspect, for example, that before erupting in humankind, Omicron may have brewed in a non-human animal as a result of a spillover.
sentences.zh: 例如，一些科学家怀疑，在人类中爆发之前，奥密克戎可能是在非人类动物中作为溢出的结果而酝酿的。

sentences.en: Its unusually large number of mutations, compared with the original variant, around 50, including more
sentences.zh: 与原始变种相比，它异常大量的突变，约50个，包括超过

sentences.en: than 30 embedded in its spike protein, nearly three times as many as the Delta variant, suggest a recent
sentences.zh: 30个嵌入其刺突蛋白中的突变，几乎是德尔塔变种的三倍，这表明它最近

sentences.en: past inside an unusual host that forced it to evolve novel adaptations to survive.
sentences.zh: 在一种不寻常的宿主体内度过，迫使它进化出新的适应性以生存。

sentences.en: Which species that unusual host hailed from remains obscure remains obscure?
sentences.zh: 那个不寻常的宿主究竟是哪个物种，目前仍不清楚。

sentences.en: Seven of Omicron's mutations are linked to adaptation in rodents.
sentences.zh: 奥密克戎的七个突变与啮齿动物的适应性有关。

sentences.en: Any likely contender would have to be a species able to contract the coronavirus from humans, and also to pass it along to both humans and non-human animals.
sentences.zh: 任何可能的竞争者都必须是一个能够从人类感染冠状病毒，并且也能将其传播给人类和非人类动物的物种。

sentences.en: So far, other than the still-shadowy creature that likely ferried the coronavirus from bats to humans
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，除了那个很可能最初将冠状病毒从蝙蝠传给人类的神秘生物外，

sentences.en: in the first place, the only non-human species known to have accomplished that feat is Neo-Vicin-Vicin, the American mink.
sentences.zh: 唯一已知完成这一壮举的非人类物种是美洲水貂。

sentences.en: There's no evidence that mink played any role in incubating the Omicron variant, but their biology and living conditions render them ideal hosts for incubating others.
sentences.zh: 没有证据表明水貂在孵化奥密克戎变种中发挥了任何作用，但它们的生物学特性和生活条件使它们成为孵化其他变种的理想宿主。

sentences.en: When the novel coronavirus first erupted on two mink farms in the Netherlands, the world's fourth-largest producer of mink pelts, in late April 2020,
sentences.zh: 当新型冠状病毒首次在荷兰（世界第四大水貂皮生产国）的两个水貂养殖场爆发时，是在2020年4月下旬，

sentences.en: the Dutch government shut down streets around the farms, conducted mandatory screenings of all mink farms,
sentences.zh: 荷兰政府关闭了农场周围的街道，对所有水貂养殖场进行了强制筛查，

sentences.en: quarantined infected farms, and instructed farm workers to don personal protective equipment.
sentences.zh: 隔离了受感染的农场，并指示农场工人穿戴个人防护装备。

sentences.en: It didn't work.
sentences.zh: 这没用。

sentences.en: By early May, two more mink farms reported outbreaks.
sentences.zh: 到5月初，又有两个水貂养殖场报告了疫情。

sentences.en: By the end of the month, the Dutch government started gassing all the mink on affected farms, many of them kits just a few weeks old.
sentences.zh: 到月底，荷兰政府开始对受影响农场的所有水貂进行毒气处理，其中许多是才几周大的幼崽。

sentences.en: They screened any mink who died on a mink farm for coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 他们对水貂养殖场中任何死亡的水貂都进行了冠状病毒筛查。

sentences.en: They banned transport of mink and of mink manure.
sentences.zh: 他们禁止运输水貂和水貂粪便。

sentences.en: That didn't work either.
sentences.zh: 那也没用。

sentences.en: By the end of July, investigators detected the coronavirus on 27 mink farms in the Netherlands.
sentences.zh: 到7月底，调查人员在荷兰的27个水貂养殖场检测到了冠状病毒。

sentences.en: Jim Keen, a former United States Department of Agriculture veterinary epidemiologist, calculated that each farm produced enough virions to infect millions of people,
sentences.zh: 美国农业部前兽医流行病学家吉姆·基恩计算出，每个农场产生的病毒颗粒足以感染数百万人，

sentences.en: an explosion of virus that was equivalent, he said, to having a decent-sized stadium where everyone is infected at the same time.
sentences.zh: 他说，这种病毒的爆发相当于有一个相当大的体育场，里面每个人同时被感染。

sentences.en: In the months after coronavirus first appeared on Dutch mink farms, outbreaks popped up in mink farming countries across Europe.
sentences.zh: 在冠状病毒首次出现在荷兰水貂养殖场后的几个月里，欧洲各地的水貂养殖国都出现了疫情。

sentences.en: In Denmark, coronavirus infected more mink than people.
sentences.zh: 在丹麦，感染冠状病毒的水貂比人还多。

sentences.en: As in humans, the virus could spread among mink asymptomatically, and even farms that recovered from outbreaks could be reinfected again, studies showed.
sentences.zh: 研究表明，和人类一样，病毒可以在水貂中无症状传播，即使是从疫情中恢复过来的农场也可能再次被感染。

sentences.en: Finally, after the mink incubated a novel strain of the virus, the Danish prime minister ordered the mass slaughter of the nation's 17 million farmed mink.
sentences.zh: 最终，在水貂孵化出一种新型病毒株后，丹麦首相下令大规模扑杀全国1700万只养殖水貂。

sentences.en: And a dozen countries in Europe, including the Netherlands and Poland, banned or phased out fur farming.
sentences.zh: 欧洲十几个国家，包括荷兰和波兰，禁止或逐步淘汰了毛皮养殖。

sentences.en: Austria and the Netherlands spearheaded an effort to end fur farming across the
sentences.zh: 奥地利和荷兰带头努力结束整个

sentences.en: European Union.
sentences.zh: 欧盟的毛皮养殖。

sentences.en: Spillbacks confound our containment strategies.
sentences.zh: 溢回现象扰乱了我们的遏制策略。

sentences.en: In theory, we can tame pathogens that prey exclusively on homo sapiens.
sentences.zh: 理论上，我们可以驯服专门捕食智人的病原体。

sentences.en: We can change our behaviors to make transmission difficult.
sentences.zh: 我们可以改变行为，使传播变得困难。

sentences.en: We can stop drinking waste-contaminated water, making the transmission of cholera difficult.
sentences.zh: 我们可以停止饮用受污染的水，使霍乱的传播变得困难。

sentences.en: We can protect our homes with mosquito screens, making the transmission of malaria difficult.
sentences.zh: 我们可以用蚊帐保护我们的家，使疟疾的传播变得困难。

sentences.en: We can eradicate a pathogen altogether, as we did smallpox through a global vaccination campaign.
sentences.zh: 我们可以彻底根除一种病原体，就像我们通过全球疫苗接种运动根除天花一样。

sentences.en: But once a pathogen spills back from humans into wild animals, those options slip away.
sentences.zh: 但一旦病原体从人类溢回到野生动物身上，这些选择就消失了。

sentences.en: For we have even less control over the behavior of non-human animals than we do over our fellow humans.
sentences.zh: 因为我们对非人类动物行为的控制力甚至比对同类人类的控制力还要小。

sentences.en: Well, now it's in fish, it's in frogs, it's in primates.
sentences.zh: 好吧，现在它在鱼类、青蛙、灵长类动物身上都有。

sentences.en: The disease ecologist Barbara Hahn says, how are you going to get rid of that?
sentences.zh: 疾病生态学家芭芭拉·哈恩说，你打算怎么摆脱它？

sentences.en: While the United
sentences.zh: 虽然美国

sentences.en: States has spent millions of dollars surveilling low-income countries overseas for possible
sentences.zh: 已经花费数百万美元在海外低收入国家监测野生动物向人类传播的可能

sentences.en: spillovers from wild animals into humans, in the United States, disease surveillance in wild species is
sentences.zh: 溢出，但在美国，对野生动物物种的疾病监测

sentences.en: mostly passive and opportunistic, designed to detect large-scale die-offs of wild animals, not the silent establishment of a pathogen in a new reservoir species.
sentences.zh: 大多是被动和机会性的，旨在检测野生动物的大规模死亡，而不是病原体在新的宿主物种中的悄然建立。

sentences.en: Finding evidence of that requires actively and systematically looking for it.
sentences.zh: 寻找这方面的证据需要主动和系统地去寻找。

sentences.en: This August, the USDA announced a new $300 million program to strengthen disease surveillance in both domestic and wild animals.
sentences.zh: 今年8月，美国农业部宣布了一项新的3亿美元计划，以加强对家畜和野生动物的疾病监测。

sentences.en: But until it gets underway in the next couple of years, the truth is, the coronavirus expert Linda Safe says, there is very little funding
sentences.zh: 但冠状病毒专家琳达·塞夫说，在未来几年该计划实施之前，事实是，几乎没有资金

sentences.en: to study these scenarios where the virus is in humans and might spill back into animals.
sentences.zh: 来研究这些病毒在人类体内并可能溢回到动物身上的场景。

sentences.en: It's likely that we may detect only that subset of coronavirus spillbacks that happen to re-emerge in humans, and in those cases
sentences.zh: 我们很可能只能检测到那些在人类身上重新出现的冠状病毒回传病例，而在这些情况下，

sentences.en: only in the rearview mirror, by piecing together genetic and other clues to reconstruct their prior forays through the bodies of animals.
sentences.zh: 我们只能事后诸葛亮，通过拼凑遗传学和其他线索，来重构它们此前在动物体内穿梭的路径。

sentences.en: Describing the gaps in disease surveillance of non-human species, the veterinary pathologist Tracy McNamara, who was involved in the discovery of a West Nile virus
sentences.zh: 兽医病理学家特雷西·麦克纳马拉（Tracy McNamara）在描述非人类物种疾病监测的空白时说，她曾参与发现1999年纽约市的西尼罗河病毒，

sentences.en: outbreak in New York City in 1999, after first observing it in birds, said, I am ripping my hair out.
sentences.zh: 当时她是在鸟类身上首次观察到该病毒，她说：“我简直要抓狂了。”

sentences.en: Our national emblem is the bald eagle.
sentences.zh: 我们的国徽是秃鹰。

sentences.en: But watching all this unfold, we need to change it to the ostrich.
sentences.zh: 但看着这一切发生，我们有必要把它改成鸵鸟。

sentences.en: It's not just that our surveillance systems are unsystematic.
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是因为我们的监测系统缺乏系统性。

sentences.en: Their underlying logic creates gaps that actively obscure the spillback phenomenon.
sentences.zh: 其潜在的逻辑所造成的空白，反而主动掩盖了病毒回传现象。

sentences.en: For spillback pathogens, cities full of people, colonies of free-living animals, and herds of captive animals are an unbroken continuum of flesh and tissue to exploit.
sentences.zh: 对于回传病原体而言，挤满人类的城市、自由生活的动物群落以及圈养的畜群，都是可供其利用的、连绵不断的血肉组织。

sentences.en: But for our surveillance systems, humans, wildlife, and domesticated animals are separated into three distinct biotic spheres,
sentences.zh: 但在我们的监测系统中，人类、野生动物和家养动物被分成了三个截然不同的生物圈，

sentences.en: monitored by different entities with peculiar jurisdictions and distinct technical approaches.
sentences.zh: 由拥有特殊管辖权和不同技术手段的实体分别监测。

sentences.en: Those creatures that defy our ontological categories, the supposedly tamed captives that go feral,
sentences.zh: 那些挑战我们本体论分类的生物，比如那些本应被驯化却又野化的圈养动物，

sentences.en: for example, or the wild creatures intimately embedded in civilized spaces, can escape notice entirely.
sentences.zh: 或者那些深入文明空间的野生生物，往往完全逃脱了我们的视线。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁了吗？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道，你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果能让你免费试用《时报》一个月，且无需绑定信用卡呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall, to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能读到什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用程序，获取30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: The way we talk about the movement of pathogens tends to obscure a confounding reality.
sentences.zh: 我们谈论病原体传播的方式，往往掩盖了一个令人困惑的现实。

sentences.en: We talk about microbes that spill over and back, as if they rightly belong in some container other than our bodies, in which their presence is accidental.
sentences.zh: 我们谈论那些在物种间来回传播的微生物，仿佛它们本该属于我们身体之外的某个容器，它们出现在我们体内纯属偶然。

sentences.en: We talk about microbes that jump from animal bodies into ours, as if they must surmount a chasm to find their way from one to the other.
sentences.zh: 我们谈论那些从动物身体跳跃到我们体内的微生物，仿佛它们必须跨越一道鸿沟才能找到从一个物种转移到另一个物种的路径。

sentences.en: But we are animals among animals, sharing a planet roiled by microbes.
sentences.zh: 但我们也是动物，是与万物共享这颗被微生物搅得天翻地覆的星球的动物。

sentences.en: For many pathogens, the borders between species are as permeable as a sponge.
sentences.zh: 对于许多病原体来说，物种间的界限就像海绵一样渗透性极强。

sentences.en: By engineering strange and intimate encounters between other infected species, we inevitably implicate our own bodies, too.
sentences.zh: 通过在其他受感染物种之间制造奇怪而亲密的接触，我们不可避免地也牵连到了我们自己的身体。

sentences.en: Take Morbillivirus, a family of viruses that is among the deadliest and most infectious viruses on the planet, killing up to 95% of those infected for the first time.
sentences.zh: 以麻疹病毒（Morbillivirus）为例，这是一个地球上最致命、传染性最强的病毒家族，首次感染者的死亡率高达95%。

sentences.en: In humans, the virus is known as measles.
sentences.zh: 在人类中，这种病毒被称为麻疹。

sentences.en: But that moniker obscures its travels across species, both before and after its tenure in Homo sapiens.
sentences.zh: 但这个称呼掩盖了它在智人身上出现之前和之后，在不同物种间的传播历程。

sentences.en: Morbillivirus spilled over into humans from cattle, in whom it causes a devastating disease known as rinderpest, or cattle plague, sometime in the 10th century.
sentences.zh: 麻疹病毒大约在公元10世纪从牛身上传播到人类，它在牛身上引起一种被称为牛瘟的毁灭性疾病。

sentences.en: The virus surged through human populations in waves in the Old World, and then in the New World, following the era of European conqueSt.
sentences.zh: 这种病毒在欧洲征服时代之后，先是在旧大陆，随后在新大陆的人类群体中一波又一波地激增。

sentences.en: But its fitful journey did not stop in Homo sapiens.
sentences.zh: 但它断断续续的旅程并没有在智人身上停止。

sentences.en: The bodies of Native Americans, many of whom died of measles, were likely scavenged by dogs.
sentences.zh: 许多死于麻疹的美洲原住民的遗体，很可能被狗啃食过。

sentences.en: Conquistadors may have even fed Native children to dogs, as depicted in the 16th century account by the Spanish priest Bartolomé de las Casas,
sentences.zh: 西班牙神父巴托洛梅·德拉斯·卡萨斯（Bartolomé de las Casas）在16世纪关于欧洲殖民美洲的记述中，
zh_words: 巴托洛梅·德拉斯·卡萨斯

sentences.en: of Europeans' colonization of the Americas.
sentences.zh: 甚至提到征服者可能曾将原住民儿童喂狗。

sentences.en: In 1735, a novel disease that looked a lot like Morbillivirus in humans broke out in dogs in Ecuador and Peru.
sentences.zh: 1735年，一种看起来很像人类麻疹病毒的新型疾病在厄瓜多尔和秘鲁的狗群中爆发。

sentences.en: Because the virus causes distinctive lesions on the teeth of puppies, the veterinary pathologist Elizabeth Yule determined that it had not been present in pre-Columbian dogs,
sentences.zh: 由于该病毒会在幼犬的牙齿上留下独特的病变，兽医病理学家伊丽莎白·尤尔（Elizabeth Yule）确定，这种病毒在哥伦布时代之前的狗身上并不存在，

sentences.en: whose entombed teeth she examined.
sentences.zh: 她检查了那些被埋葬的狗牙。

sentences.en: Based on those findings and other research,
sentences.zh: 基于这些发现和其他研究，

sentences.en: Yule and her colleagues suggested in a 2019 paper that Morbillivirus must have spilled back from people into dogs.
sentences.zh: 尤尔和她的同事在2019年的一篇论文中提出，麻疹病毒一定是先从人类回传到了狗身上。

sentences.en: It's now a major pathogen of dogs, causing the disease known as distemper.
sentences.zh: 它现在是狗的主要病原体，引起了被称为犬瘟热的疾病。

sentences.en: That spillback allowed the virus to conquer a wide range of other domesticated animals and wild animals.
sentences.zh: 这种回传使该病毒征服了广泛的其他家养动物和野生动物。

sentences.en: Its list of conquests now includes species from five different orders and two families of non-human primates, from dolphins and porpoises to various endangered species.
sentences.zh: 它的征服名单现在包括来自五个不同目和两个科的非人类灵长类动物，从海豚和鼠海豚到各种濒危物种。

sentences.en: Distemper reached farmed mink from infected dogs.
sentences.zh: 犬瘟热通过受感染的狗传播到了养殖水貂身上。

sentences.en: The mink industry's subsequent attempt to contain distemper tipped another line of dominoes, unleashing a pathogen even more difficult to control.
sentences.zh: 水貂行业随后试图控制犬瘟热的举措，引发了另一连串的连锁反应，释放出一种更难控制的病原体。

sentences.en: In the mid-20th century, mink farmers typically used a distemper vaccine on their farmed mink, consisting of the ground-up spleens of distemper-infected mink mixed with saline.
sentences.zh: 20世纪中期，水貂养殖户通常给养殖水貂接种犬瘟热疫苗，这种疫苗由感染犬瘟热的水貂脾脏研磨后与生理盐水混合而成。

sentences.en: But unknown to them, the concoction included a pathogen now known as carnivore amdoparvovirus 1.
sentences.zh: 但他们不知道的是，这种混合物中包含了一种现在被称为食肉动物阿米多细小病毒1型（carnivore amdoparvovirus 1）的病原体。

sentences.en: The growing international trade in specially bred mink spread the virus to mink farms around the world.
sentences.zh: 日益增长的特种繁育水貂国际贸易将该病毒传播到了世界各地的水貂养殖场。

sentences.en: Mink farmers soon found out that amdoparvovirus 1 was even harder to contain than distemper.
sentences.zh: 水貂养殖户很快发现，阿米多细小病毒1型比犬瘟热更难控制。

sentences.en: The viral infection caused a progressive wasting syndrome that could kill infected minks and their unborn kits.
sentences.zh: 这种病毒感染会导致进行性消瘦综合征，可能杀死受感染的水貂及其未出生的幼崽。

sentences.en: Worse, the virus was highly durable in the environment and, unlike distemper, resistant to vaccines.
sentences.zh: 更糟糕的是，这种病毒在环境中具有极强的耐受性，而且与犬瘟热不同，它对疫苗有抗性。

sentences.en: Once infected with amdoparvovirus 1, mink farms became perpetual reservoirs of these viruses, the microbiologist Andrew Lang says.
sentences.zh: 微生物学家安德鲁·朗（Andrew Lang）说，一旦感染了阿米多细小病毒1型，水貂养殖场就成了这些病毒的永久储存库。

sentences.en: To eradicate it, mink farms would need to slaughter all their mink and rebuild their mink populations from scratch.
sentences.zh: 为了根除它，水貂养殖场需要宰杀所有水貂，并从零开始重建种群。

sentences.en: By the time the mink industry adopted measures to prevent amdoparvovirus 1 from entering their farms by protecting uninfected mink from infected mink,
sentences.zh: 当水貂行业采取措施，通过保护未感染水貂免受感染水貂的侵害来防止阿米多细小病毒1型进入养殖场时，

sentences.en: measures that would do little to protect farmed mink from pathogens carried by infected humans, mdoparvovirus 1 had spilled back into wild species.
sentences.zh: 这些措施对于保护养殖水貂免受受感染人类携带的病原体侵害几乎无济于事，而阿米多细小病毒1型早已回传到了野生动物身上。

sentences.en: That's because mink farms are notoriously leaky.
sentences.zh: 这是因为水貂养殖场以“漏风”著称。

sentences.en: Cognitively complex and communicative, mink regularly escape the confines of fur farMs.
sentences.zh: 水貂认知复杂且善于交流，经常逃出毛皮养殖场的束缚。

sentences.en: People in mink farming areas like the Utah Valley post on private Facebook groups
sentences.zh: 在犹他谷等水貂养殖区，人们会在私人的Facebook群组里发帖，

sentences.en: about escaped mink that turn up in their yards, terrorizing their pets and killing their backyard chickens.
sentences.zh: 谈论出现在他们院子里的逃跑水貂，它们恐吓宠物并杀死后院的鸡。

sentences.en: Animal control officers won't always collect escaped mink, an animal advocate in Utah told me, because they consider them wild animals outside their purview.
sentences.zh: 一位犹他州的动物权益倡导者告诉我，动物管制人员并不总是会去捕捉逃跑的水貂，因为他们认为那是超出其职权范围的野生动物。

sentences.en: Mink farmers don't want them back either.
sentences.zh: 水貂养殖户也不想把它们抓回来。

sentences.en: Because of the risk, they may have interacted with wild mink and picked up a pathogen such as amdoparvovirus 1.
sentences.zh: 因为存在风险，它们可能与野生水貂接触过，并携带了阿米多细小病毒1型等病原体。

sentences.en: That leaves escapees free to take amdoparvovirus 1, coronavirus, or any other pathogen they pick up on the farm into the wild.
sentences.zh: 这使得逃跑的水貂可以自由地将阿米多细小病毒1型、冠状病毒或它们在养殖场携带的任何其他病原体带入野外。

sentences.en: They do.
sentences.zh: 它们确实这么做了。

sentences.en: In one study, 82% of the wild mink living in an Ontario county where mink farms were common had antibodies to amdoparvovirus 1,
sentences.zh: 在一项研究中，安大略省一个水貂养殖场密集的县，82%的野生水貂体内都有阿米多细小病毒1型的抗体，

sentences.en: while none of the wild mink studied in a distant, non-mink farming county did.
sentences.zh: 而在一个遥远的、没有水貂养殖的县，所研究的野生水貂体内则完全没有。

sentences.en: Amdoparvovirus 1 has also been discovered in British Columbia in over 41% of wild adult mink and nearly 4% of martens, and in more than a quarter of striped skunks in California.
sentences.zh: 在不列颠哥伦比亚省，超过41%的野生成年水貂和近4%的貂类，以及加利福尼亚州超过四分之一的条纹臭鼬体内也发现了阿米多细小病毒1型。

sentences.en: Scientists don't know how prevalent amdoparvovirus 1 was in wild populations before the mink farm outbreaks.
sentences.zh: 科学家们不知道在水貂养殖场爆发疫情之前，阿米多细小病毒1型在野生种群中的流行程度如何。

sentences.en: Now, however, they suspect that its ravages are contributing to the decline of wild mink in Canada and to the dire plight faced by the native European mink in Europe,
sentences.zh: 然而现在，他们怀疑它的肆虐正导致加拿大野生水貂数量的减少，以及欧洲本土欧洲水貂所面临的严峻困境，

sentences.en: one of the continent's most threatened mammals.
sentences.zh: 这是欧洲受威胁最严重的哺乳动物之一。

sentences.en: Amdoparvovirus 1 infected mink on farms may have spread the virus to humans, too.
sentences.zh: 养殖场感染阿米多细小病毒1型的水貂也可能将病毒传播给了人类。

sentences.en: A 2009 paper in Emerging Infectious Diseases describes the cases of two mink farmers in Denmark
sentences.zh: 2009年《新发传染病》杂志上的一篇论文描述了丹麦两名水貂养殖户的病例，

sentences.en: who fell ill with a strange disease that appeared similar to the illness that amdoparvovirus 1 causes in mink.
sentences.zh: 他们患上了一种奇怪的疾病，看起来与阿米多细小病毒1型在水貂身上引起的疾病相似。

sentences.en: One farmer had to be repeatedly hospitalized.
sentences.zh: 其中一名养殖户不得不反复住院。

sentences.en: Another had to have his leg amputated before dying at age 40.
sentences.zh: 另一名在40岁去世前不得不截肢。

sentences.en: Scientists found amdoparvovirus-specific antibodies and amdoparvovirus DNA in both.
sentences.zh: 科学家在两人体内都发现了阿米多细小病毒特异性抗体和病毒DNA。

sentences.en: Mink belonged to the mustelid family of animals, which includes weasels, badgers, otters, martens, wolverines, and ferrets.
sentences.zh: 水貂属于鼬科动物，其中包括黄鼠狼、獾、水獭、貂、狼獾和雪貂。

sentences.en: Ferrets' vulnerability to respiratory pathogens is so similar to our own that scientists who study respiratory diseases commonly use them as experimental subjects.
sentences.zh: 雪貂对呼吸道病原体的易感性与我们非常相似，因此研究呼吸道疾病的科学家通常将其用作实验对象。

sentences.en: Scientists had pinpointed mink as a likely animal model in which to study the pathogenesis of coronaviruses 16 years ago in the wake of the first global SARS outbreak.
sentences.zh: 16年前，在首次全球SARS疫情爆发后，科学家们就已确定水貂是研究冠状病毒发病机制的理想动物模型。

sentences.en: The lung cells of neovicin-vicin, scientists reported in 2006, have ACE2 receptors, to which SARS coronaviruses can bind.
sentences.zh: 科学家在2006年报告称，美洲水貂的肺细胞具有ACE2受体，SARS冠状病毒可以结合到这些受体上。

sentences.en: Mink farms offered uniquely amenable conditions for coronavirus to spread.
sentences.zh: 水貂养殖场为冠状病毒的传播提供了独特的有利条件。

sentences.en: Unlike humans, who can take precautionary measures to avoid contracting the coronavirus, caged mink are trapped in a high-transmission environment,
sentences.zh: 与可以采取预防措施避免感染冠状病毒的人类不同，笼养水貂被困在高传播环境中，

sentences.en: in wire cages the size of cat travel crates, lined up in long rows in sheds that house thousands of animals.
sentences.zh: 它们被关在猫用航空箱大小的铁丝笼里，在容纳数千只动物的棚舍中排成一长排。

sentences.en: Such conditions are as salutary for the spread of respiratory viruses as a high-density prison.
sentences.zh: 这种条件对于呼吸道病毒的传播来说，就像高密度监狱一样有利。

sentences.en: And unlike a prison, a mink shed has no plumbing.
sentences.zh: 而且与监狱不同的是，水貂棚舍没有排水系统。

sentences.en: We focus a lot on the respiratory transmission among people,
sentences.zh: “我们非常关注人与人之间的呼吸道传播，”

sentences.en: Jonathan Epstein, a zoonotic disease ecologist, says.
sentences.zh: 人兽共患病生态学家乔纳森·爱泼斯坦（Jonathan Epstein）说。

sentences.en: But it's important to remember that this is also a GI tract virus, and it's shed in the stool.
sentences.zh: “但必须记住，这也是一种胃肠道病毒，会通过粪便排出。”

sentences.en: While we flush our own infected excreta down porcelain toilets, the excreta of mink collects under their cages in dank mounds, in which coronavirus can remain infectious for days,
sentences.zh: 虽然我们把受感染的排泄物冲进瓷质马桶，但水貂的排泄物却堆积在笼子下潮湿的土堆里，冠状病毒可以在其中保持传染性数天，

sentences.en: long enough to be aerosolized when farm workers shovel it away.
sentences.zh: 足以在农场工人铲除它们时形成气溶胶。

sentences.en: It's probable that the factory farm conditions that minks are subjected to make them especially susceptible to microbial pathogens.
sentences.zh: 水貂所处的工厂化养殖条件很可能使它们特别容易受到微生物病原体的侵害。

sentences.en: Notwithstanding their undeniably adorable exteriors, alert, wide-set eyes, dainty, partly-webbed paws, and long, furry bodies, mink are not sociable herd animals,
sentences.zh: 尽管水貂外表可爱，有着警觉、宽距的眼睛，精致、半蹼的爪子和长长的毛茸茸的身体，但它们并不是群居动物，

sentences.en: like cows, sheep, chickens, and pigs, who have been under human domestication for thousands of years.
sentences.zh: 不像牛、羊、鸡和猪那样，已经被人类驯化了数千年，

sentences.en: Exchanging microbes back and forth with one another, and with us.
sentences.zh: 在彼此之间以及与我们之间交换微生物。

sentences.en: They are solitary, meat-eating predators, unaccustomed to life and intimate proximity to other individuals.
sentences.zh: 它们是独居的食肉捕食者，不习惯与其他个体亲密接触的生活。

sentences.en: Just how the stress of crowding affects mink is unknown, though it is thought to suppress their immune systeMs.
sentences.zh: 拥挤带来的压力如何影响水貂尚不清楚，但人们认为这会抑制它们的免疫系统。

sentences.en: Farmed mink are famously vulnerable to pathogens such as distemper and influenza.
sentences.zh: 养殖水貂以容易感染犬瘟热和流感等病原体而闻名。

sentences.en: Mink farmers must pump them up with vaccinations to keep them alive for the handful of months it takes for them to grow thick fur.
sentences.zh: 水貂养殖户必须给它们注射大量疫苗，才能让它们在长出厚毛所需的短短几个月内存活下来。

sentences.en: I was told by Michael Whalen, then a mink industry spokesman, that farmers in the United States had developed strict biosecurity measures
sentences.zh: 时任水貂行业发言人的迈克尔·惠伦（Michael Whalen）告诉我，美国的养殖户已经制定了严格的生物安全措施，

sentences.en: to prevent microbial transmission between humans and animals on mink farMs.
sentences.zh: 以防止水貂养殖场内人类与动物之间的微生物传播。

sentences.en: Livestock operations, such as poultry farms, for example, often require that workers wear Tyvek suits, masks, and booties,
sentences.zh: 例如，家禽养殖场等畜牧业经营场所通常要求工人穿戴泰维克（Tyvek）防护服、口罩和鞋套，

sentences.en: and shower in and shower out of the fully sealed sheds where captive animals are kept.
sentences.zh: 并在进入和离开完全封闭的圈养动物棚舍时进行淋浴。

sentences.en: And yet, many of the mink farms I visited in Utah didn't even have adequate fencing around their borders.
sentences.zh: 然而，我参观过的许多犹他州水貂养殖场，甚至连边界都没有足够的围栏。

sentences.en: The rickety perimeter gate around one farm I saw was open to passing traffic, including the cows in an adjacent clearing, the deer of which nearby roadway signs warned,
sentences.zh: 我看到的一个农场周围摇摇欲坠的围栏大门对过往车辆敞开，包括邻近空地上的牛、路边标志警告过的鹿，

sentences.en: and a band of feral cats that slinked onto the farm's gravel lot just yards from the doorless mink sheds.
sentences.zh: 还有一群野猫，它们溜进了距离无门水貂棚舍仅几码远的农场碎石地上。

sentences.en: Unlike in Europe, health officials in the United States did not conduct active surveillance on mink farms for coronavirus, relying instead on mink farmers to self-report outbreaks.
sentences.zh: 与欧洲不同，美国的卫生官员没有对水貂养殖场进行冠状病毒的主动监测，而是依赖水貂养殖户自行报告疫情。

sentences.en: Publicly, industry representatives said they took the risk of coronavirus incursions seriously.
sentences.zh: 在公开场合，行业代表表示他们认真对待冠状病毒入侵的风险。

sentences.en: But privately, many were almost dismissive about the threat the virus posed.
sentences.zh: 但在私下里，许多人对病毒构成的威胁几乎不屑一顾。

sentences.en: One mink farmer, Joe Roof, described coronavirus in mink as a non-event when we spoke by phone.
sentences.zh: 一位水貂养殖户乔·鲁夫（Joe Roof）在电话中称水貂冠状病毒为“小事一桩”。

sentences.en: The industry trade group, Fur Commission USA, called it a supposed public health threat in an email to its members that was leaked to activists and shared with me.
sentences.zh: 行业贸易组织“美国毛皮委员会”（Fur Commission USA）在一封泄露给活动人士并分享给我的邮件中，称其为“所谓的公共卫生威胁”。

sentences.en: And when word got out that I was visiting Utah mink farms,
sentences.zh: 当我要去参观犹他州水貂养殖场的消息传出后，

sentences.en: Fur Commission USA sent out a security alert to its members with a photograph of my rental car and its license plates.
sentences.zh: 美国毛皮委员会向其成员发送了一份安全警报，附上了我的租车照片及其车牌号。

sentences.en: Do not let her onto your property, and under no circumstances allow her near the mink sheds, it read,
sentences.zh: “不要让她进入你的房产，在任何情况下都不要让她靠近水貂棚舍，”上面写道，

sentences.en: because any pictures or documented cases of ranches that are not following the recommended biosecurity protocols could damage our efforts to defend the U.S.
sentences.zh: “因为任何关于未遵守建议生物安全规程的牧场的照片或记录在案的病例，都可能损害我们捍卫美国生产商的努力。”

sentences.en: producers.
sentences.zh: （接上句）

sentences.en: As a relatively small industry that sells most of its animal products overseas as garments rather than as food, mink farms have escaped most regulatory oversight.
sentences.zh: 作为一个相对较小的行业，其大部分动物产品作为服装而非食品销往海外，水貂养殖场逃避了大部分监管审查。

sentences.en: Federal laws that pertain to animals, like the Animal Welfare Act and the Humane Slaughter Act, do not cover animals on fur farMs.
sentences.zh: 涉及动物的联邦法律，如《动物福利法》和《人道屠宰法》，并不涵盖毛皮养殖场里的动物。

sentences.en: Few states require mink farms to be licensed or inspected.
sentences.zh: 很少有州要求水貂养殖场获得许可或接受检查。

sentences.en: None require veterinary oversight.
sentences.zh: 没有一个州要求进行兽医监督。

sentences.en: Like most states, Utah has no regulations on fur farming at all.
sentences.zh: 像大多数州一样，犹他州根本没有任何关于毛皮养殖的法规。

sentences.en: Even the minimal containment strategies devised for infected mink farms proved difficult to implement.
sentences.zh: 即使是为受感染水貂养殖场制定的最低限度的控制策略，也被证明难以实施。

sentences.en: In Utah, mink farmers were fairly resistant to having anyone come onto their facilities, the Utah state veterinarian Dean Taylor told me.
sentences.zh: 犹他州兽医迪恩·泰勒（Dean Taylor）告诉我，在犹他州，水貂养殖户相当抵触任何人进入他们的设施。

sentences.en: In internal correspondence acquired through public records requests,
sentences.zh: 在通过公共记录请求获得的内部通信中，

sentences.en: Utah Health Department officials discussed an infected farm that the department was not permitted to access, even for testing.
sentences.zh: 犹他州卫生部门官员讨论了一个该部门不被允许进入的受感染农场，甚至无法进行检测。

sentences.en: Unregulated, secretive mink farms, Han says, are not that different, if you think about it, from these captive wildlife farms that we hear about in Asia.
sentences.zh: 韩（Han）说，不受监管、隐秘的水貂养殖场，如果你仔细想想，与我们在亚洲听说的那些圈养野生动物农场没什么两样。

sentences.en: On the 12 mink farms that reported outbreaks, health officials implemented quarantines, testing protocols, and trapping programs to capture and test nearby animals.
sentences.zh: 在报告疫情的12个水貂养殖场，卫生官员实施了隔离、检测规程和诱捕计划，以捕捉和检测附近的动物。

sentences.en: Unlike in Europe, there were no culls of susceptible or infected mink.
sentences.zh: 与欧洲不同，这里没有对易感或受感染的水貂进行扑杀。

sentences.en: While in 2014 and 2015, the USDA paid $200 million to compensate farmers for culling 50 million farmed birds to short-circuit an outbreak of avian influenza,
sentences.zh: 虽然美国农业部在2014年和2015年支付了2亿美元，补偿农民扑杀5000万只养殖禽类以阻断禽流感疫情，

sentences.en: the agency had no budget to do the same to prevent coronavirus from exploding on mink farMs.
sentences.zh: 但该机构没有预算采取同样的措施来防止冠状病毒在水貂养殖场爆发。

sentences.en: The mink outbreak that began in August 2020 in the United States eventually engulfed 18 farms in four states.
sentences.zh: 2020年8月在美国开始的水貂疫情最终波及了四个州的18个农场。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, the seepage of farmed mink into the broader environment continued as usual.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，养殖水貂向更广泛环境中的渗透仍在照常进行。

sentences.en: Activists liberated captive mink, as they have for years, sneaking onto mink farms in Utah and Idaho and unlatching the cages of 2,000 mink, who fled into the moonlight.
sentences.zh: 活动人士像往年一样解放了圈养水貂，他们潜入犹他州和爱达荷州的水貂养殖场，解开了2000只水貂的笼子，它们逃进了月色中。

sentences.en: Scientists for the USDA and the Centers for Disease Control captured more than 250 mink in and around Utah mink farms that were able to interact with other wildlife,
sentences.zh: 美国农业部和疾病控制中心的科学家在犹他州水貂养殖场内外捕捉到了250多只能够与其他野生动物接触的水貂，

sentences.en: government scientists wrote in a 2021 paper in the journal Viruses.
sentences.zh: 政府科学家在《病毒》杂志2021年的一篇论文中写道。

sentences.en: A third were infected with coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 其中三分之一感染了冠状病毒。

sentences.en: How many others successfully escaped the virus in tow is unknown.
sentences.zh: 还有多少其他水貂成功逃脱并携带了病毒，目前尚不清楚。

sentences.en: Despite piecemeal surveillance, scientists in the United States have detected the pathogen spread into at least two free-living wild species.
sentences.zh: 尽管监测零散，但美国的科学家已经检测到该病原体传播到了至少两种自由生活的野生动物物种中。

sentences.en: USDA scientists discovered coronavirus in a wild mink they trapped near a pile of mink carcasses on a quarantined mink farm in Utah and discovered antibodies to the virus
sentences.zh: 美国农业部科学家在犹他州一个被隔离的水貂养殖场的一堆水貂尸体附近捕获的一只野生水貂身上发现了冠状病毒，并发现了病毒抗体，

sentences.en: in 40% of samples taken from white-tailed deer in Illinois, Michigan, New York, and Pennsylvania.
sentences.zh: 在伊利诺伊州、密歇根州、纽约州和宾夕法尼亚州采集的白尾鹿样本中，40%发现了该病毒的抗体。

sentences.en: In an unpublished study,
sentences.zh: 在一项未发表的研究中，

sentences.en: Penn State veterinary microbiologists reported finding viral RNA in a third of samples taken from white-tailed deer in Iowa.
sentences.zh: 宾夕法尼亚州立大学的兽医微生物学家报告称，在爱荷华州采集的白尾鹿样本中，有三分之一发现了病毒RNA。

sentences.en: Presumably, the wild mink contracted the virus from infected mink farMs.
sentences.zh: 据推测，野生水貂是从受感染的水貂养殖场感染了病毒。

sentences.en: The white-tailed deer were probably infected by humans, with whom they come into frequent contact because of suburban sprawl's encroachment on their habitat.
sentences.zh: 白尾鹿很可能是被人类感染的，由于郊区扩张侵占了它们的栖息地，它们与人类频繁接触。

sentences.en: These studies are but a peek into the pathogen's travels into the non-human world.
sentences.zh: 这些研究只是窥见了病原体进入非人类世界的一角。

sentences.en: No study analyzed samples collected randomly, so results can't be extrapolated to estimate the prevalence of coronavirus in wild species.
sentences.zh: 没有研究分析随机采集的样本，因此结果无法外推来估算冠状病毒在野生动物中的流行率。

sentences.en: In both the United States and in Europe, coronavirus variants incubated on mink farms turned up in people, including those with no association to mink farming.
sentences.zh: 在美国和欧洲，在水貂养殖场孵化的冠状病毒变体都出现在了人类身上，包括那些与水貂养殖无关的人。

sentences.en: Health officials detected at least three.
sentences.zh: 卫生官员至少检测到了三种。

sentences.en: The Cluster 5 variant, now extinct, which was first detected in captive mink and farm workers in Denmark.
sentences.zh: Cluster 5变体，现已灭绝，最初是在丹麦的圈养水貂和农场工人身上发现的。

sentences.en: The Marseille 4 variant, which first showed up in humans in a mink farming area of France with 13 mutations never seen before and presumed to originate in mink.
sentences.zh: Marseille 4变体，最初出现在法国一个水貂养殖区的人类身上，带有13种从未见过的突变，推测起源于水貂。

sentences.en: And the Michigan mink variant, which was discovered in mink farm workers and also a taxidermist who had no known links to mink farMs.
sentences.zh: 还有密歇根州的水貂变异株，它是在水貂养殖场工人和一名与水貂养殖场并无已知关联的标本剥制师身上发现的。

sentences.en: That meant that the variant, as the state's Department of Health speculated in April 2021, is already circulating in the community.
sentences.zh: 这意味着，正如该州卫生部在2021年4月所推测的那样，该变异株已经在社区中传播。

sentences.en: There is so little genetic sequencing of the viruses infecting people in the United States that it is impossible to know for sure.
sentences.zh: 美国对感染人类的病毒进行的基因测序太少了，以至于无法确定具体情况。

sentences.en: The COVID outbreak on United States mink farms eventually subsided at the end of the year after farmers slaughtered 80 to 90 percent of their animals to sell their pelts.
sentences.zh: 美国水貂养殖场的新冠疫情最终在年底平息，因为养殖户宰杀了80%到90%的动物以出售皮毛。

sentences.en: But so long as the novel coronavirus lurks among us, susceptible species beckon.
sentences.zh: 但只要新冠病毒还在我们中间潜伏，易感物种就会面临威胁。

sentences.en: The range of species that are biologically vulnerable to coronavirus infection is broad.
sentences.zh: 在生物学上容易感染冠状病毒的物种范围很广。

sentences.en: The enzyme ACE2, a receptor to which the virus binds, appears to be essential for mammals, who have retained the genes that code for it
sentences.zh: ACE2酶是病毒结合的受体，对哺乳动物来说似乎至关重要，它们保留了编码该酶的基因，

sentences.en: despite taking otherwise divergent evolutionary paths.
sentences.zh: 尽管它们走上了截然不同的进化道路。

sentences.en: With each new host comes new possibilities to evolve new modes of transmission and disease pathologies, which can extend the range of possible hosts yet again.
sentences.zh: 每一个新的宿主都带来了进化出新的传播方式和疾病病理的可能性，这可能会再次扩大潜在宿主的范围。

sentences.en: Species that are not susceptible to today's variants, for example, may be vulnerable to tomorrow's.
sentences.zh: 例如，对当今变异株不敏感的物种，可能对未来的变异株易感。

sentences.en: A discovery made serendipitously when researchers found that the beta and gamma variants could infect lab mice, while the original alpha strain,
